parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese.
- en: English.

parameters.name: ExtGrayRules
parameters.description: The list of additional canary release rules. When performing listener matching, the additional canary release rules are merged with existing rules for matching.

sub_parameters.name: GrayRule
sub_parameters.description: The canary release rule. If it is a Beta canary release, this field contains the IP addresses of the canary release clients, separated by commas. If it is a tag-based canary release, this field contains tag_name=tag_value, with multiple tag values separated by commas.

sub_parameters.name: GrayRuleName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the canary release version.

sub_parameters.name: GrayRulePriority
sub_parameters.description: The priority of the canary release version.

sub_parameters.name: GrayRuleType
sub_parameters.description: The type of the canary release rule.

parameters.name: NamespaceId
parameters.description: The namespace ID. Default value: public.

parameters.name: RequestPars
parameters.description: This parameter is deprecated and does not need to be specified.
